l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_02_adv_voice_linkstory_miku_shizuku_10598_037_f69f935b
l2d_voice#2.Text: 谢谢你，心玖。 我又知道了一件新的事情

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_06_adv_voice_linkstory_raika_shizuku_10589_007_142edbe7
l2d_voice#2.Text: 贵安，吸・尘奇。 我是四宫宁月

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_07_spot_05_02_04_shizuku_01_tap
l2d_voice#2.Text: ……能够看出非同一般的努力痕迹

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_08_adv_voice_kadan_005_1_09_028_ac618a01
l2d_voice#2.Text: ……只是这种程度的话我还是会弹的

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_09_adv_voice_anotherstory_10458_005
l2d_voice#2.Text: 咦……是客人吗～？ 现在还没到营业时间哦～

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_10_spot_05_01_02_shizuku_01_after
l2d_voice#2.Text: 我也不知道。本来想解开，结果却缠上了

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_11_spot_05_02_03_shizuku_02_tap_6c6649dd
l2d_voice#2.Text: 仅凭热水便能做出料理，真是不可思议……

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_12_adv_voice_anotherstory_10458_009
l2d_voice#2.Text: 啊，是刚住进宿舍的那个孩子…… 等等，你才初中？

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_13_adv_voice_anotherstory_10458_013
l2d_voice#2.Text: 蕾叶，可不能让这孩子在这里做兼职哦～ 我会被抓起来的

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_14_adv_voice_eventstory_8_01_032
l2d_voice#2.Text: 原来劳动是这么辛苦的事啊。 我也想做出更多贡献，可是……

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_15_adv_voice_anotherstory_10458_015
l2d_voice#2.Text: 兼职得等到了高中生才能做。 明白了就快把她带回宿舍去～

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_16_adv_voice_anotherstory_10458_017
l2d_voice#2.Text: 又来啦～你和那位奶奶都一个样， 整天把『Family』挂在嘴边……
